title: Workload pack asset graph
description: A pack's assets.yaml: what continuous ops keeps fresh. traust-engine reads deps, partitions, trigger, priority, freshness and admission to plan and admit orders; runners read run, params, runner, model, writes, riders and outcomes to execute an order from their pinned copy of the pack (the order carries only the asset name and typed params); preflight reads enabled and requires to refuse before any work when a requirement is unmet. Strict: an unknown key is an error for all readers.

budget.description: The pack's budget; lanes are budgeted in the deployment config.

route_on.description: The asset whose materialization re-routes a repository through the pack router.

partitions.description: One order per repository in the inventory; absent means one fleet-wide order.

priority.description: Lower runs sooner; routed orders take the router's priority.

every.description: Due again this long after the last attempt.

on_cron.description: Due at each time this five-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, UTC) names, unless attempted since; for jobs with a clock time.

lanes.description: Planned only when the pack router routes a repository to one of these lanes.

approval.description: The approver group that must approve each order.

estimate_usd.description: Cost of one order, charged against its lane's budget; absent means unknown cost, never withheld.

key.description: Token bucket key; {host} is the repository's forge host, e.g. forge:{host}.

run.description: argv template, no shell; placeholders name params.

params.description: Param name to its value type, e.g. repo_url: HttpsRepoUrl.

enabled.description: The only way to keep an asset in the pack without its requirements: preflight skips a disabled asset instead of checking what it needs. Absent means enabled.

requires.description: What preflight (traust doctor, engine start, platform doors) checks before any order of this asset runs; every unmet item fails with its fix. Absent means no requirements.

tools.description: External tool names, spelled as in traust-core's shipped external-tools.yaml; the version floor comes from that pin, never repeated here.

config.description: traust.yaml top-level keys (traust.schema.json), plus model-registry for model-registry.yaml. Keys with a convention default when unset: home, database, artifacts, process, http, logging, rating, ledger, identity, forge_hosts, forge_tokens, feeds, execution, locations, overrides; the rest must be set.

facts.description: Adopter facts recorded in traust-core, by their artifact names; preflight checks each record exists.

feeds.description: Feed source ids from traust-core's shipped feeds.yaml registry; preflight checks the source is enabled and reachable by tier.

secrets.description: Environment variable names, as traust.yaml's *_env keys name them; preflight checks each resolves to a value.
